title: Behavioral Fingerprint & Contextual Separation (Core vs. Domain)

universal_core_behaviors.anti_hallucination_bias: Zero tolerance for AI speculation. The user explicitly forbids the AI from guessing without evidence.
universal_core_behaviors.visual_bridging: When the AI is stuck or misunderstands a complex UI issue, the user captures a video to visually train the AI, acting as an empirical bridge.
universal_core_behaviors.first_principles_analysis: Reduces problems to fundamental truths before executing solutions.

job_ai_agent_sandbox.context: These are NOT universal life rules. They are explicit constraints injected specifically when running the Job AI Agent for real candidate profiles to meet HR standards.
rules: Verification commands (CDP port 9222, programmatically checking PDF pages) are troubleshooting tactics used specifically when the Job AI Agent drifts, not general life habits.

core_insight: Sophron must strictly differentiate between the User's universal cognitive identity (deep thinking, empirical proof) and the specific tactical commands the User issues to govern the Job Agent (Resume pages, ATS rules).
